instruction: Look up the most recent open pull request in "kubernetes/kubernetes" labeled "kind/bug". Save it in the format "#<number> | <labels> | <title>" to "$HOME/Desktop/gh_open_prs_3_2.txt". If none exists, save an empty file.
reference_command: gh pr list --repo kubernetes/kubernetes --search 'label:"kind/bug" sort:created-desc' --limit 1 --json number,title,labels --jq '.[] | "#\(.number) | \(([.labels[].name] | if length == 0 then "none" else join(",") end)) | \(.title)"' > "$HOME/Desktop/gh_open_prs_3_2.txt"
